variation.name: bir51_tc_foreign_currency
variation.description: A valid BIR51 tax computation where the entity's functional currency is not HKD. CurrencyUsed is set to a valid ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD) and ConversionRate is the applicable exchange rate (not 1). All monetary facts in the TC file use a USD-denominated unit. The paired FS file must also use USD-denominated monetary units.
